note: The upstream handoff described 118 warning groups. Exact artifact parsing found 117 unclosed-database ResourceWarnings plus one unrelated Starlette TestClient deprecation warning. The first remediation removed 111 warnings from SQLiteControlPlaneStore lifetime mismatch; exact-head CI then isolated the remaining six to raw sqlite3 tamper fixtures in security-core and security-edge tests.
remediation: SQLiteControlPlaneStore uses an explicit contextmanager with connection.close() in finally.
Six test-owned raw sqlite3 tamper connections use contextlib.closing.
No warning filters, ResourceWarning suppression or durability PRAGMA changes were used.

root_causes.production_store_lifecycle: SQLiteControlPlaneStore._connect returned a raw sqlite3.Connection used as a transaction context manager; sqlite3.Connection.__exit__ commits or rolls back but does not close.
root_causes.test_fixture_cleanup: Six corruption/tamper fixtures in test_control_plane_security_core.py and test_control_plane_security_edges.py used the same raw sqlite3 context-manager pattern.
